Moraira · Costa Blanca

Essence

Four architect-designed villas on a Mediterranean hillside, each turned to the sea.

The development

A small collection, built to the land it sits on.

Four homes by architect José Giner Ivars, set on their own plots above Moraira with open views to the Mediterranean. Every villa here is drawn from its real floorplans and placed on the true terrain — not an impression, the actual site.

4 villas1,128–1,413 m² plots310–415 m² builtTeulada–Moraira, Alicante
